rule.text: The project stopped work on this pending function and recorded why. It is never ported, never tested equivalent and never added to the verified count. Approved by Glib on Oct 28, 2026 (stop the ledger tail).

reasons.census_unsplit_floor: The census left this span unsplit (a floor), and the lifter refuses its jump tables into code, so it cannot be ported or tested.
reasons.impossible_direction_unproved: Every instruction runs on the original bytes and the translation agrees on all scenarios; the one jump direction left is impossible by construction, and the prover (run with the scenarios) did not discharge it.
reasons.needs_alias_model_in_prover: A direction needs a pointer into the stack or an overlap between two pointers. Glib kept the no-alias assumption, but the prover has no alias model yet (a lea address reaches only cells at or above it, calls havoc those).
reasons.needs_callee_footprint_model: One direction is infeasible by reading the code, but the proof needed a callee-footprint model that was removed after review found gaps.
reasons.needs_frame_assumption_in_prover: Coverage is full except a direction that is impossible in the original, but a frame object is handed to a library call, so the prover's frame assumption is off; it would clear with a stated assumption that such a call writes only inside the object.
reasons.needs_loop_invariants: Only a crash path is left; the forward window loses a frame cell at counting-loop headers, so it needs loop invariant entries (tests/fl73_invariants.json).
reasons.needs_multi_cell_or_aliased_state: The search reached everything except a few jump directions that need three or more cells to line up (a pointer aliasing the function's own pushes, wrapped address arithmetic, tail jumps with moved stacks), and the prover answers reachable.
reasons.no_scenarios_yet: No scenario run reached more than the entry of this large function (or every run timed out); coverage is zero or negligible.
reasons.original_faults_on_every_scenario: The original faults on every generated scenario, so there is nothing to compare against.
reasons.partial_coverage_gate_not_built: Scenarios cover part of the function; the remaining code sits behind a gate whose state was not built (see the note for the coverage reached).
reasons.prover_window_times_out: Scenarios cover everything that can run; the remaining directions are provably impossible in principle (loops and copies of equal data) but every prover window times out.
reasons.translation_mismatch_open: New scenarios disagree between the translation and the original; the translation has a defect that has not been fixed.
